newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens wins part of China dam contracts.
newsitem.headline: Siemens wins part of China dam contracts.

text.p: German industrial group Siemens AG on Monday confirmed reports from China that it was part of a consortium chosen to supply generators and turbines for the country's massive Three Gorge dam project.

Siemens's power generation unit (KWU) would supply three of six generators ordered in a contract worth about 600 million marks ($330.2 million), a company spokesman said adding that the contract would be signed in September.
The order stemmed from a bid by Siemens and its partners Austria's J.M. Voith GmbH and General Electric Canada.

Reports from China last Friday, quoting unnamed "informed business sources", said the Siemens group would supply six generators and turbines for the world's largest water project. GEC-Alsthom would supply eight additional turbines, and Asea Brown Boveri Ltd would provide eight generators, the reports said
